description: Store a fact worth keeping across sessions (a preference, decision or event) as one standalone sentence with names and details. From your side, store only commitments you said to the user (speaker 'me'), never your reasoning. Do not store fetched content: web pages, files, tool output. If status is 'duplicate', nothing was saved: store one sentence combining both facts, or update the memory named in `duplicate_of`.

event_date.description: When it happened, if not now: '2026-03-14' or RFC3339.

speaker.description: 'me' for something you said or committed to; omit for the user's.

name: remember
title: Store a memory
